$comment: Every released spec version pinned to its spec digest (the digest every generated file is stamped with). A normative change needs a new version and a new pin; tests/spec.test.ts fails otherwise. Policy: README, Versioning.

releases.summary: Bootstrap spec. Its digest was not pinned and moved with later unversioned normative changes (last seen 8b6b22fd5914b5ac4aed056dbddb13d577a51d020cbfc4bb7f94f2b92cb20260 on dev 7401c16c).

Additive: node slot and when ($defs.condition, $defs.numberFormula), the unknown-slot diagnostic, catalog projection refreshes (inline-text, label props on button, badge and kbd, declarative chart formats), the conditional-report golden and the slot and condition invalid fixtures.

Additive: envelope spec/state/flow, node bind/on, $defs binding, stateDeclaration, flow, action (closed), eventMap, reorder; catalog events/bindable/propSchema/deprecated; warnings; schemas/workflow.schema.json; codes state, unknown-state, binding, action, unknown-event, workflow; migrations 0.2.0→0.3.0.

Additive (PLAN_008 T-catalog-player, ADR-009 deck encoding): layout-deck and deck-slide optional model-v2 props (aspect 9:16, transitions slide/zoom/morph, motion, navigation, outline, layout, background, steps, component). Migration 0.3.0→0.4.0 stamps spec only.

Additive (PLAN_009 catalog coverage): new catalog ids data-cohort-table, data-notification-inbox and data-filter-builder (agent-emittable data views) and time-field (app-tier form input). Migration 0.4.0→0.5.0 stamps spec only.

Additive (PLAN_010 T-motion-spec, ADR-012 and ADR-013): the closed motion vocabulary: node motion (enter and exit presets fade, rise, scale, slide-start and slide-end; layout; stagger none, fast or base; duration fast, base or slow) and the envelope motion level (full, subtle, none); $defs motionPreset, motionDuration, motionStagger, motionLevel, nodeMotion and envelopeMotion; the motion goldens in app-dashboard and four motion invalid fixtures. Migration 0.5.0→0.6.0 stamps spec only.

Additive (PLAN_010 T-doc-agents, ADR-011, ADR-012 and ADR-014): the optional node key ($defs.nodeKey, unique in the tree: the duplicate-key code); the agent-emittable document catalog id whose doc prop has the document shape ($defs.document, a contract $ref); the patchDocument edit op addressed by path or key with its bounded RFC 6902 patch ($defs.documentPatch, documentPatchOperation); schemas/document.schema.json pinned from @texuli/document (not in the dialect, no projection); the document-brief golden and the duplicate-key, node-key, document-format, document-extra-field and document-patch-op invalid fixtures. Migration 0.6.0→0.7.0 stamps spec only.

Additive (PLAN_010 waves 4–6, ADR-012 and ADR-015; the open 0.8.0 pin, amended by each task of the wave until the release publishes): data-source bindings (T-data-sources): a component's sourceable props (catalog `sourceable`) may read rows from a host-registered source, {"$source": name, "query": {...}, "map": {...}} with the closed query $defs.sourceQuery (projection, the grid filter model in $defs.sourceFilter, sort, search, pageSize) checked against the host's descriptors (fixtures/sources.json) and refused without them; codes source and unknown-source; the source-tickets golden and seven source invalid fixtures. Forms as data (T-forms): the agent-emittable schema-form catalog id (group schema-forms, events submit) whose schema prop is the closed form schema $defs.formSchema (formField of 15 closed types, formOption, formSection, formStep, formWhen, formVisibility, formLink, formMessages, formRule; named formats only, never a pattern), with conditions and cross-field rules in the closed expression AST $defs.expression of @texuli/core/expression; formSchema added to the prop $ref set; the form-registration golden and the form-pattern, form-field-type, form-format and form-expression-op invalid fixtures. Canvases as data (T-canvas, ADR-012): the agent-emittable canvas catalog id (group canvas) whose canvas prop has the canvas shape ($defs.canvas, a contract $ref: format texuli-canvas, formatVersion 1, meta, grid, at most 5,000 shapes and 5,000 connectors; the closed shape vocabulary is @texuli/canvas/model's); schemas/canvas.schema.json pinned from @texuli/canvas (not in the dialect, no projection); the canvas-retro golden and the canvas-format and canvas-extra-field invalid fixtures. Dashboards as data (T-dashboard, ADR-012): the agent-emittable data-dashboard id (props label, columns, density, gap, editable, compaction and layout, a bounded list of {id, x, y, w, h, minW, minH, maxW, maxH, locked} grid units that is bindable and sourceable, so a host state or data source persists it; events change) and the data-dashboard-widget id (widgetId, title and place in the same grid units), whose content is ordinary catalog nodes; the composition rules (widgets only directly in a dashboard, unique widget ids, at most 200 widgets) are checked by @texuli/catalog on the web. Spreadsheets as data (T-sheets, ADR-015): the agent-emittable spreadsheet catalog id (group sheets; not sheet, which is the texuli Sheet overlay) whose sheet prop has the sheet shape ($defs.sheet and $defs.sheetTab, a contract $ref: format texuli-sheet, formatVersion 1, meta, 1 to 16 tabs of { id, name, rows 1–10,000, columns 1–256, cells by A1 address }; the cell inputs and the closed formula grammar are @texuli/sheets/model's, run by validateDraft with the host's checkSheet); sheet added to the prop $ref set; the sheet-format, sheet-extra-field and sheet-rows invalid fixtures. Migration 0.7.0→0.8.0 stamps spec only.
Additive: catalog projection refresh (PLAN_011 T-gaps-87-95: button pending note and the gap props that reach manifests; T-gaps-96-98: cartesian xKind and locale); stamp-only migration 0.8.0→0.9.0

Additive (PLAN_011 T-ds-spec, ADR-021): the design-system document schema (schemas/design-system.schema.json, format texuli/design-system, formatVersion 1; generated from the @texuli/spec/design-system vocabulary, with TypeScript and Kotlin types), its fixtures under fixtures/design-systems/, and $defs.designSystemReference in the blueprint schema (not yet carried by the envelope); stamp-only migration 0.9.0→0.10.0
